div.head: Wif 4
div.ab: Gif hit swa geforword bið, ðonne is riht, þæt heo sy healfes orfes wyrðe – 7 ealles, gif hy cild gemæne habban –, bute heo eft wær ceose.
Si sic quoque conueniant, rectum est, ut dimidiam pecuniam habeat — et totam, si puerum simul habuerint —, nisi deinceps uirum capiat.
Gif hit swa geforword bið, þonne is riht, ðæt heo sy healfes yrfes wyrðe — 7 ealles, gif hy cild gemæne habban —, bute heo eft wær ceose.
If it is thus contracted, then it is right that she should be entitled to half the goods— and to all, if they have a child together—unless she marries again.

Wenn das [Verlöbniss] so [wie gesagt] formell verabredet worden ist, dann ist gesetzlich, dass sie [als Witwe] den halben Nachlass (Viehbestand B) [des Mannes] geniessen werde — und den ganzen, wenn sie Nachkommenschaft gemeinsam erhalten —, ausser wenn sie wiederum einen Gatten wählt.

If [the betrothal] has been formally agreed in this way [as said], then it is lawful that she [as a widow] shall enjoy half of [the husband's] estate (livestock, B) — and the whole, if they have children together — unless she chooses a husband again.
div.note: In B ‘Gif hit swa ge’ is written twice.; U: checked against Whitelock, EHD I (1979), and corrected (before: ‘And if it is thus contracted, then it is right that she should be entitled to half the goods – and to all, if they have a child together – unless she marries again.’).
